text:
ria: Quick UX sync — noticed the table column resize handle overlaps the action column on compact layouts, and toasts sometimes sit above the resize handle making it hard to grab.

omar: saw that on the accounts table. when density=compact the column gutters shrink and the 8px handle becomes effectively 4px touch area.

jin: same pattern we saw elsewhere: keep visual handle thin but expand hit target to 44px. we should add a semantic token for column-handle hit area instead of reusing spacing tokens.

ria: proposal: `--table-col-handle-hit: 44px` + CSS: `.col-handle { width: var(--table-col-handle-hit); margin-left: calc(-1 * var(--table-col-handle-hit) / 2); } .col-handle .visual { width:8px; }` so visuals unchanged but interaction area large.

omar: also toasts are using top-right by default and z-index stacking sometimes places them above handles. simplest fix: toast respects `--interactive-overlay-z` or we increase handle z-index when dragging. Which is better?

jin: prefer to keep toasts above content but let interactive drag handles have higher z-index during pointerdown only. avoid changing global toast stacking. Add `--dragging-z: 8000` applied on drag start.

ria: accessibility notes: ensure handle has `role=separator` and `aria-orientation=horizontal` and keyboard support (left/right arrow to resize). add visible `:focus-visible` outline using `--focus-ring`.

omar: small copy/label nit: when a user pins columns we show a toast that says "Columns pinned". change to "Column layout saved" to avoid confusion with pin-to-top.

jin: agree. I'll patch the ARIA roles and keyboard handlers in the PR. Also will add unit tests for pointerdown z-index and focus-visible.

design-bot: Task CREATE COMPONENTS-821 "table: column-handle hit area token, drag z-index during interaction, aria roles & keyboard resize, toast copy tweak" Target milestone 2.22.0.

ria: action items recap: 1) add `--table-col-handle-hit` token, 2) implement visual/interaction CSS (keep 8px visual), 3) apply high z-index during drag, 4) aria/keyboard support + focus token, 5) update toast copy to "Column layout saved".

omar: I'll prototype CSS in a small branch and attach before/after screenshots.

jin: will own accessibility tests and PR.

design-bot: Logged. Resolving thread once PRs merge.
